messages.subject: Pennington Industries - written representations
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Inspector Whitlow,

Further to our meeting on 4 March, please find the Company's written representations attached. In summary: the Company accepts that the guarding and the maintenance of the interlock fell short and that breaches of regulation 11 PUWER and section 2(1) HSWA occurred in respect of PT-DB-07; it asks that culpability be assessed as medium given the designed-in control and otherwise functioning system; and it sets out its co-operation and remediation. We will provide the forensic report and audit summary by 31 March.

Yours sincerely,
Sarah Whitfield

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Pennington Industries - written representations
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you for the representations and the forensic report. I am considering the appropriate course. I am minded to accept that culpability is medium and harm category 2, subject to the audit summary. I will revert on whether the matter proceeds to prosecution on an agreed basis or otherwise.

Karen Whitlow
